en: A black-and-white winter scene showing a snow-covered town with people walking and skiing on the streets. There are several large buildings, including a prominent white building in the background that appears to be of public or institutional use (possibly a school or government facility). The foreground has leafless trees and a wooden fence, with a few smaller houses visible. The text 'Parti av Kiruna' is printed in the lower left corner, and there is a round logo with the word 'ÄKTA' in the lower right.
